baseline_requirements: Primary workload: conversational support (short-turn chat), secondary: document search and reranking. Baseline steady-state: 200 QPS (chat requests) averaging 60 tokens per request => ~12k tokens/sec steady. Peak: burst up to 1,000 QPS for 3-10 minute events => ~60k tokens/sec peak. Latency targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms for short chat (<=128 tokens). Throughput requirement: sustain concurrent KV-cache-enabled sessions + 30% headroom. Failover: cross-region fallback acceptable but want <100ms extra penalty.
workshop_summary: Workshop goals: validate baseline QPS, measure tokens/sec across model candidates, recommend reserved GPU mix, quantify burst strategy. Outcome (expected): recommend 8 x H100-80GB equiv. reserved nodes for steady-state with autoscale pool of 4 nodes for burst (burst routing to spare dedicated pool or cheaper model variant). Suggest prefix/KV caching to cut token generation by ~20-30% for common flows. Recommend canary rollout lane and A/B latency checks before full production switch.
recommended_reserved_gpu_plan: Steady: 8x H100-80GB (reserved) to meet 200 QPS steady at target latency with KV cache. Burst: 4x on-demand H100 for predictable peaks (or pre-warmed dedicated burst pool). Redundancy: spread across 2 AZs, 1:1 hot-standby for maintenance windows. Expected committed monthly spend: estimate in pricing deck (see drive link).
sla_negotiation_notes: Customer requests explicit p95 latency SLO with credits. Proposed terms: 99.9% uptime + p95 latency banding for chat endpoints; credit schedule escalates for repeated misses. Legal asks: sample breach clause and data residency clause for US-only. SE to draft SLO measurement approach (route-level metrics + token accounting) and include audit hooks for third-party verification.
pricing_expectation: Prefers 12-month commitment with quarterly true-ups. Wants price protection for model kernel changes and an option for burst credits. Looking for clear unit economics per 1k tokens for each model family and a committed discount structure.
blocker_details: Security team needs formal answers on: key management (bring-your-own-kms), audit log retention policy (7+ years requested), and feasibility of air-gapped on-prem adapter for sensitive workloads. Legal: needs SLA draft; procurement to confirm budget in April.
